metrics.profile_summary: Senior digital marketing professional with over 4 years of experience specializing in SEO, SMM, and B2B/B2C growth. Proven track record in leading teams and executing data-driven campaigns to increase organic traffic and lead generation.

experience.description: Leading B2B/B2C growth through Meta ads, semantic/programmatic SEO, and the development of TOFU/MOFU/BOFU content funnels.
Led global digital marketing efforts focusing on Meta campaigns, CRO, SEO, and B2B lead generation using Apollo and SimilarWeb.
Managed technical SEO audits, GMB optimization, and organic SMM growth using Meta Business Suite.
Executed SEO and SMM strategies for SAAS and e-commerce clients, optimizing Shopify/WooCommerce stores and managing Meta assets.

strengths: Expert proficiency in Meta Business Suite and Canva
Extensive experience in social media growth and content strategy
Strong analytical skills with GA4 and GSC
weaknesses: Educational background is in Engineering rather than Marketing
May be overqualified for a Specialist-level role
evaluation.summary: The candidate exceeds the minimum experience and technical requirements. He possesses all the 'nice-to-have' skills and has a proven history of managing the exact platforms and tasks required for the Marketing Specialist role.
